description: Paid: 0.005 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.005 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Blank FIM 2026 two-way inter-consideration ledger template: parties (principal, broker, agent), what each side owes per duty with status open, met or unmet, plus adjustments. Fill it in per engagement. Static reference content; not legal advice. Payments are final per call. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.
